title: Default Models Registry
description: `crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/default_models.json`, embedded at compile time via `include_str!` and parsed at runtime. Rust (`DefaultModels`/`DefaultModelEntry`) only reads `default`, `web_search`, `image_description`, `session_summary`, and `models[].model` — every other property below is part of the full on-disk key set (verified against the real file) that Rust ignores as forward-compatible unknown data, presumably consumed elsewhere (UI/model-picker code) rather than by this loader. A runtime assertion (not expressible in this schema) requires `default` to equal one of `models[].model`; enforce that invariant in the validation harness, not via JSON Schema alone. Model resolution order at runtime: CLI flag > ENV var > config.toml > remote settings > these defaults.

default.description: Primary model id for coding tasks and general fallback. Required field on `DefaultModels`; must equal one of `models[].model` (enforced by a runtime `assert!`, not by Deserialize).

web_search.description: Model id for web search tool synthesis. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent.

image_description.description: Model id for image description. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent.

session_summary.description: Model id for session title generation. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent.

models.description: Model catalog. Required field on `DefaultModels` (`Vec<DefaultModelEntry>`); Rust itself only deserializes each item's `model` field, the rest is documented from the real on-disk file.

modelEntry.description: Single model catalog entry. Only `model` is required by `DefaultModelEntry`; every other property is the full on-disk key set observed in the real `default_models.json`, not enforced by this Rust loader.

id.description: Stable catalog identifier for this model entry. On-disk-only field, not read by `DefaultModelEntry`.

model.description: Model id string used for resolution/matching against `default`/`web_search`/`image_description`/`session_summary`. Required field on `DefaultModelEntry`.

context_window.description: Context window size in tokens. On-disk-only field.

api_backend.description: Backend API this model is served through (e.g. "responses"). On-disk-only field.

supports_backend_search.description: Whether the backend supports native search for this model. On-disk-only field.

system_prompt_label.description: Label surfaced to the model within the system prompt. On-disk-only field.

show_model_fingerprint.description: Whether to surface the model fingerprint in the UI. On-disk-only field.

supports_reasoning_effort.description: Whether this model accepts a configurable reasoning effort. On-disk-only field.

reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort value for this model (e.g. "high"). On-disk-only field.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description: Context-usage percentage threshold that triggers auto-compaction. On-disk-only field.

compaction_at_tokens.description: Whether compaction is measured in absolute tokens (as opposed to percentage only). On-disk-only field.

compactions_remaining.description: Number of compactions remaining before a hard session limit. On-disk-only field.

reasoning_efforts.description: Selectable reasoning-effort presets for this model. On-disk-only field.

reasoningEffort.description: One selectable reasoning-effort preset. On-disk-only shape.

description.description: Human-readable description of the tradeoffs at this effort level.

default.description: Whether this preset is the default for the model. Present only on the default entry in the real file; absent on others.
